name: Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology
short_description: This qualification reflects the role of individuals who perform a broad range of tasks on a variety of light vehicles in the automotive retail, service and repair industry.
hero_description: Are you working 20+ hours per week performing automotive electrical services in vehicles? With Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL), you can use your existing skills and work experience to gain this qualification without classroom study.

overview.label: Qualification Overview
overview.title: Certify Your Skills and Advance Your Career
overview.description: If your daily work involves diagnosing, servicing, installing, and repairing electrical wiring, electronic modules, ignition systems, and auxiliary electronics in modern motor vehicles, certifying your capability with an official AUR30320 Certificate III can help formalise your existing skills and experience.

benefits.title: No Classroom Sitting
benefits.description: Convert your existing on-the-job vehicle service experience into recognised units of competency without interrupting your paid job.

benefits.title: Fast-Track Timeline
benefits.description: Achieve your certificate in an estimated 4 to 12 weeks once your workplace evidence, videos, and referee reports are compiled.

benefits.title: Trade Licensing Ready
benefits.description: AUR30320 provides the foundational technical qualification relevant to trade licensing and motor vehicle repair requirements.

benefits.title: Higher Earning Potential
benefits.description: Formal trade credentials can help position experienced automotive electricians for higher-level roles and specialist opportunities.

faq.question: Am I eligible for RPL recognition?
faq.answer: If you have relevant work experience, informal training, or existing skills in automotive electrical systems — such as working on vehicle electrical services — you may be eligible. A free preliminary assessment can help determine your suitability.

faq.question: What evidence is required to qualify?
faq.answer: Standard evidence may include work logs, photos or videos of completed work, employer references, a resume detailing relevant experience, payslips, previous transcripts or certificates. An assessor confirms the exact requirements for your situation.

faq.question: How long does the RPL process take?
faq.answer: The estimated duration is around 4–12 weeks depending on your existing experience, the quality of your evidence and any outstanding assessment requirements.

faq.question: Is this qualification nationally recognised?
faq.answer: Yes. AUR30320 – Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology is a nationally recognised Australian qualification. Training and assessment are provided through the relevant Registered Training Organisation.

faq.question: Do I need to attend any classes?
faq.answer: No classroom attendance may be required when completing the qualification through an RPL pathway. RPL assesses the skills and knowledge you already have. If gaps are identified, additional training or assessment may be recommended.
